companions.name: DIRECT V12650 M31C B
companions.description: The secondary star of DIRECT V12650 M31C, an eclipsing pair of hot stars in the Andromeda Galaxy, 15.0 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; the two eclipse each other every 3.549694 days.

radius.source: Secondary radius 11.3 +/- 0.3 solar radii, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2

mass.source: Secondary mass 15.0 +/- 1.1 solar masses, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2

temperature.source: Secondary Teff 27700 +/- 500 K, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2

orbit.source: M31V J00443799+4129236: P 3.549694 d, time of primary minimum HJD 2452204.421, i 89.3 degrees and a 33.0 +/- 0.7 solar radii (Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2); a circular orbit was adopted in the fit (Sect. 3). a/R = 33.0/13.1 = 2.5191 primary radii. HJD is taken as BJD_TDB (under a minute apart); at the primary minimum the primary is eclipsed, so the secondary is in front.

text.card: The secondary star of an eclipsing pair in the Andromeda Galaxy, one orbit every 3.549694 days.
text.introduction: It has 15.0 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; its partner has 23.1 and 13.1. The pair gave a direct distance to the galaxy: 772 kiloparsecs.
text.locator: Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2: M, R, P and the distance
